title: Costume Attendants
description: Select, fit, and take care of costumes for cast members, and aid entertainers. May assist with multiple costume changes during performances.

tasks.text: Create worksheets for dressing lists, show notes, or costume checks.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Prepare operational reports from data

tasks.text: Provide dressing assistance to cast members or assign cast dressers to assist specific cast members with costume changes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assignments drafted; accountability and negotiation human

dwas.name: Assign duties or work schedules to employees.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Arrange costumes in order of use to facilitate quick-change procedures for performances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Arranging items is physical placement

dwas.name: Arrange items for use or display.

tasks.text: Design or construct costumes or send them to tailors for construction, major repairs, or alterations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Costume concepts generated; physical fabrication human

dwas.name: Design costumes or cosmetic effects for characters.

tasks.text: Examine costume fit on cast members and sketch or write notes for alterations.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material quality often needs hands-on or visual inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of materials or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Distribute costumes or related equipment and keep records of item status.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Supply inventory tracking and reorder largely automatable

dwas.name: Distribute resources to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Check the appearance of costumes on stage or under lights to determine whether desired effects are being achieved.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Judging aesthetic quality needs human taste

tasks.text: Clean and press costumes before and after performances and perform any minor repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual cleaning of fabrics with unpredictable materials

tasks.text: Collaborate with production designers, costume designers, or other production staff to discuss and execute costume design details.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live collaborative negotiation of production details needs human presence

dwas.name: Collaborate with others to determine production details.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Monitor, maintain, or secure inventories of costumes, wigs, or makeup, providing keys or access to assigned directors, costume designers, or wardrobe mistresses/masters.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Supply inventory tracking and reorder largely automatable

dwas.name: Monitor availability of equipment or supplies.

tasks.text: Purchase, rent, or requisition costumes or other wardrobe necessities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Study books, pictures, or examples of period clothing to determine styles worn during specific periods in history.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Extract requirements from production docs, human tailors

dwas.name: Review production information to determine costume or makeup requirements.

tasks.text: Return borrowed or rented items when productions are complete and return other items to storage.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Review scripts or other production information to determine a story's locale or period, as well as the number of characters and required costumes.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Extract requirements from production docs, human tailors

dwas.name: Review production information to determine costume or makeup requirements.

tasks.text: Inventory stock to determine types or conditions of available costuming.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Digital tracking automatable; physical stock checks need humans

dwas.name: Monitor availability of equipment or supplies.

tasks.text: Direct the work of wardrobe crews during dress rehearsals or performances.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing service workers requires live human presence

tasks.text: Participate in the hiring, training, scheduling, or supervision of alteration workers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

tasks.text: Provide managers with budget recommendations and take responsibility for budgetary line items related to costumes, storage, or makeup needs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Budget management aided by AI, human owns decisions

dwas.name: Manage budgets for personal services operations.

tasks.text: Assign lockers to employees and maintain locker rooms, dressing rooms, wig rooms, or costume storage or laundry areas.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Scheduling/allocation logic helps; human resolves conflicts

dwas.name: Assign resources or facilities to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Recommend vendors and monitor their work.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI flags quality/safety issues; human owns physical verification

tasks.text: Care for non-clothing items, such as flags, table skirts, or draperies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual cleaning of fabrics with unpredictable materials

emerging_tasks.task: Create patterns for costumes based on designer's drawings.
